reasoning_summary: Verified the excerpt step by step in order. (1) End of the combinatorialization proof (lines 0259-0274): the strongly-connected-component argument is loose but sound - two maximal cubes meeting in >1 vertex meet in a common face containing an edge, distinct components can only touch at single vertices, and a locally finite simply connected complex with such a touching point has a cut point, contradicting QI to H^2; the inductive extension over X_n and the local-isometry-to-isometry step (covering map between simply connected spaces) are fine. (2) Prop. strands (0366-0443): g^n central in Gamma^+ via the exponent of Aut(K) is correct; Min(g^n)=Y x R with Y bounded because X is 2-ended and Y x R is convex; Y_0 nonempty by the CAT(0) centre; independence of the choice of g checked (k in K acts trivially on Y_0, so (g')^n=g^n k has beta''=translation by |g^n|); dihedral case: r^{-1}g^n r = g^{-n}k', so d(r.x, g^n r.x)=d(x,g^{-n}.x)=|g^n|, giving r.rho_x an axis of g^n, hence Gamma-invariance of Y_0 x R and the canonical strand {c_{Y_1}} x R. All steps justified. (3) Lemma strand-classification (0460-0485): point stabilizers embed in the order-4 symmetry group of the pair {sigma^+,sigma^-} plus the two sides of the circle; circle quotient gives Z or Z+Z_2, segment quotient with |K_x|=4 gives (Z x| Z_2)+Z_2 and with |K_x|=2 gives Z x| Z_2. Correct. (4) Horostrip machinery (0544-0663): with y_1<y_2 the y=y_1 boundary really is the long side; the quadrilateral computation length(alpha)=(b-a)/y_1, length(beta)=(b-a)/y_2, leaf length = ln(y_2/y_1) checks out, so width = |ln(length alpha / length beta)|; the churro metrization width |ln(tau_core/tau_sigma_i)| and the long-side-assignment rule (long side on the core iff tau_core > tau_sigma_i) are consistent; Lemma ratio is fine because the mean is homogeneous of degree 1, so tau_core/tau_sigma_i depends only on the clutching ratios. (5) prop:global-isometry, the Dehn-twist lemma and the Assembly Lemma follow from these. (6) Coarse-intersection lemmas and prop:comb-close (0904-0984): the orbit/compact-fundamental-domain argument and the chain phi(x) in N_{D_5}(sigma_i') together with phibar(x) in the same D_5-coarse intersection give the uniform bound. (7) prop:projection (1000-1023): the tripod argument yields delta+R >= |alpha_2|=|gamma_1| and hence the stated 2(delta+R). (8) prop:clutching (1036-1150): the setup, the uniform QI constants of psi_1^{(n)} (h^n is an isometry, so prop:comb-close applies with n-independent D), m_n -> infinity, and the two independent estimates of phi(h^n y) (bounded from omega'(Q_n) via the churro width, and bounded from P_n via the isometries phibar_1, phibar_2 and the leaf-scaling factor b/a) are all correct; P_n at distance m_n a' b/a from y' is exactly where phibar_2(h^n y) sits, and it lies between y' and omega'(Q_n) precisely under the WLOG a/b > a'/b'. The only defect I found is a numerical slip in the last line: d(P_n, omega'(Q_n)) is m_n(b' - a'b/a) = m_n(ab'-a'b)/a, not the stated m_n(a/b - a'/b') = m_n(ab'-a'b)/(bb'). The two expressions have the same sign and both diverge with m_n, so the contradiction and hence a/b = a'/b' still follow; this is a non-load-bearing constant error, not a break in the argument. Remaining issues are typographical (e_k for e_i in the low-power-abelian definition, phibar_n: X_n -> X_n for X_n -> waffle_2, phi(sigma_i') for phi(sigma_i), Delta for H in the final corollary). No step fails in a way that invalidates the proof.
